title: #10 Nettan Lindgren, BMW Dealer Team Sweden BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Medium confidence. 2026-11-16: redrawn from the first left-side photo of #10: supertouring.co.uk 1991 entrants gallery page 2, 'lindgren_91.jpg', credited (c) www.stillphotography.co.uk (https://web.archive.org/web/2012/http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991_entrants_2.html, image http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991/lindgren_91.jpg, 230x160, saved in teams/_series/ask_permission/on_track), front 3/4 on track. It shows a plain white front wing (no stripe there, so the front-wing stripe from the TV drawing was removed) and one band right under the side windows, starting on the rear half of the door and running to the tail, with slanted joins: red, orange, yellow, green, dark blue; red runs up the C-pillar. Castrol is white letters on a dark green box on the rear quarter under the band. ESSO header and number board at the front of the door, SKF and other stickers on the sill, gold mesh wheels with polished lips (as before). Not drawn (unreadable): a dark word on the top of the front wing and a small red sticker above the front wheel. Earlier sources: TV graphics drawings A_grid_r01_silverstone_b_sharp_15 and A_grid_r03_donington_sharp_13; right-side frames B_right_tv Season Review 00-12-30 and C_right_tv Round 2 Pt 1 00-05-45, which had been read as BMW M colours; the left photo shows the five-colour band instead. Logos: real Castrol wordmark (white) and SKF.
